## Describe the Bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## To Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Run `aifme-scout scan 'https://example.com'`
2. With options `--timeout 10`
3. Observe error

## Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

What actually happened. Include error messages and stack traces.

## Environment

- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14, Ubuntu 22.04]
- Python version: [e.g. 3.11.4]
- AIFME Scout OSS version: [e.g. 1.0.0-rc2]
- Installation method: [e.g. pip, editable]

## Additional Context

Add any other context about the problem here. Include scan results, JSON output, or screenshots if relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for duplicates
- [ ] I have provided all requested information
- [ ] I have included a minimal reproduction case
